criteria.detail: The committed diff adds the complete Action Topbar package with source, manifest, tests, icon, license, and notices.
The root catalog links to Action Topbar and labels its install experimental.
Both READMEs and the manifest preserve the matching-core, SDK 0.4.33, and deferred marketplace boundary.
The documentation includes Git-subdirectory and local-path install commands.
The committed suite passed but did not cover or prevent a client-supplied terminal ID from closing a terminal owned by another thread.
The committed diff is scoped to Action Topbar, its repository integration, and matching workflow records relative to the correct main base.

securityCorrectness: High: closeTab accepted a client-supplied terminalId and force-closed it without verifying ownership by the requested thread. Verify terminal ownership through host state before closing.
designMaintainability: Medium: explanatory comments in the new TypeScript sources violated the repository comment rule. Remove all but the semantic oxlint directive.
